experiment._description: Controls the run name, output directory, seed program, stopping rule, and reproducibility seed.

documentation.name: Short experiment label used in the timestamped output directory name.
documentation.main_output_dir: Parent directory for all runs. The runner creates one timestamped experiment directory under this path and copies this config there as config.used.json.
documentation.seed_priority_path: Path to the initial seed priority function source file. It must define the function named by function_to_evolve.
documentation.function_to_evolve: Unversioned priority function name. FunSearch prompts will create versioned variants such as priority_v0, priority_v1, and so on.
documentation.max_cycles: Maximum number of outer evolution cycles to run.
documentation.stop_after_no_improvement_cycles: Stop early after this many consecutive cycles without a new global best score.
documentation.random_seed: Random seed used for upstream island prompt sampling and tie-breaking.

experiment.name: oracle_priority

program_database._description: Controls how many islands exist, how prompts are assembled, and how cluster sampling behaves inside each island.

documentation.functions_per_prompt: Number of previous priority functions to include in each island prompt. With value 2, established islands show two prior functions; brand-new islands show one because only the seed exists.
documentation.num_islands: Number of independent islands. Each cycle creates one sampler worker per island shard, up to sampler.parallel_workers concurrent processes.
documentation.cluster_sampling_temperature_init: Initial softmax temperature for sampling score clusters inside an island. Lower values favor high-scoring clusters more strongly.
documentation.cluster_sampling_temperature_period: Period, measured in programs registered in an island, over which the cluster sampling temperature linearly decays before restarting its schedule.

sampler._description: Controls the LLM backend, system prompt, model name, and per-island sampling cadence.

documentation.backend: Sampler backend. Use openai for the OpenAI Responses API or deterministic for local smoke tests that do not call an external model.
documentation.system_prompt_path: Text file used as the LLM system prompt or instructions. The island prompt code is passed separately as the user input to the model.
documentation.model: External model name passed to the sampler backend.
documentation.candidates_per_island_per_cycle: Number of LLM-generated priority functions per island per cycle. The sampler worker registers each accepted function into its island before requesting the next one, so later prompts reflect earlier local improvements.
documentation.parallel_workers: Maximum number of island sampler processes to run concurrently.
documentation.temperature: Optional model sampling temperature. Omit this field to let the backend use its default.
documentation.max_output_tokens: Optional maximum output token budget for the model. Remove this field to use the backend default.

evaluator._description: Controls the oracle-based scoring backend and how training/testing data pairs are preprocessed.

documentation.backend: Evaluator backend. procedure2 is the oracle plus ridge calibration path; deterministic is only for orchestration smoke tests.
documentation.metric: Held-out scoring metric. roc_auc is recommended because it measures whether calibrated scores rank cases above controls without choosing a threshold.
documentation.oracle_train_fraction: Fraction of combined training samples used as Oracle-Train. The remainder is the calibration set for ridge or logistic calibration.
documentation.preprocessed_dirname: Subdirectory inside the experiment directory where preprocessed oracle-train, calibration, and scoring pickles are stored.
documentation.calibration_penalties: Candidate ridge penalties to evaluate during calibration.
documentation.scoring_partitions: Number of scoring-set partitions evaluated in parallel for each candidate priority function. Use 1 to keep scoring single-process.
documentation.bootstrap_iterations: Number of bootstrap resamples of the scoring set used to estimate the AUC distribution. The evaluator registers the median bootstrap AUC.
documentation.dataset_pairs: Array of pair configurations. Each pair represents one training/testing condition, such as no additional covariates or additional covariates present.

dataset_pairs._description: Training/testing pickle shards for the no-additional-covariates condition.

documentation.name: Pair name used in logs, preprocessed subdirectories, and database signatures.
documentation.training_pickles: Training pickle shards that are concatenated before the 80/20 Oracle-Train/calibration split.
documentation.testing_pickles: Testing pickle shards for the held-out scoring set for this condition.
documentation.oracle_train_pickle: Optional alternative to training_pickles: a prebuilt Oracle-Train pickle path.
documentation.calibration_pickle: Optional alternative to training_pickles: a prebuilt calibration pickle path.
documentation.scoring_pickle: Optional alternative to testing_pickles: a prebuilt scoring pickle path.
documentation.has_additional_covariates: False means no extra covariate columns are expected for this pair.

dataset_pairs.name: no_covariates

dataset_pairs._description: Training/testing pickle shards for the additional-covariates condition.

documentation.name: Pair name used in logs, preprocessed subdirectories, and database signatures.
documentation.training_pickles: Training pickle shards that are concatenated before the 80/20 Oracle-Train/calibration split.
documentation.testing_pickles: Testing pickle shards for the held-out scoring set for this condition.
documentation.oracle_train_pickle: Optional alternative to training_pickles: a prebuilt Oracle-Train pickle path.
documentation.calibration_pickle: Optional alternative to training_pickles: a prebuilt calibration pickle path.
documentation.scoring_pickle: Optional alternative to testing_pickles: a prebuilt scoring pickle path.
documentation.has_additional_covariates: True means the adapter and evaluator should expect the configured covariate columns.

logging._description: Controls the verbosity of main.log and console output.

documentation.level: Standard-library logging level for main.log and console output.

priority_tools._description: Future extension point for helper modules that should be exposed to generated priority functions.

documentation.module_names: List of module names whose helper functions should be documented in the system prompt.
